```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo) 
library(forecast) 
library(tseries) 
```

```{r}
#1
#dataset

setwd("D:/time series project")
getwd()

train <- read.csv("train.csv" , stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
transactions <- read.csv("transactions.csv" , stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
oil <- read.csv("oil.csv" , stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
```{r}
#2
full_cal <- data.frame(
  date = seq(as.Date("2013-01-01"), as.Date("2017-08-15"), by = "day")
)
cat("تعداد کل روزهای تقویم کامل:", nrow(full_cal), "\n\n")

# تجمیع Sales روزانه
sales_daily <- train %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(sales = sum(sales, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("تعداد روزهای Sales قبل از تکمیل تقویم:", nrow(sales_daily), "\n")

sales_daily <- full_cal %>%
  left_join(sales_daily %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)), by = "date") %>%
  mutate(sales = replace_na(sales, 0))

cat("تعداد روزهای Sales بعد از تکمیل تقویم:", nrow(sales_daily), "\n\n")

# تجمیع Transactions روزانه
trans_daily <- transactions %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("تعداد روزهای Transactions قبل از تکمیل تقویم:", nrow(trans_daily), "\n")

trans_daily <- full_cal %>%
  left_join(trans_daily %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)), by = "date") %>%
  mutate(transactions = replace_na(transactions, 0))

cat("تعداد روزهای Transactions بعد از تکمیل تقویم:", nrow(trans_daily), "\n\n")

# تمیزکاری Oil Price
names(oil)[names(oil) == "dcoilwtico"] <- "oil_price"

oil_full <- full_cal %>%
  left_join(oil %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)), by = "date") %>%
  mutate(oil_price = na.approx(oil_price, na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
  fill(oil_price, .direction = "downup")

cat("تعداد NA باقیمانده در Oil Price بعد از interpolation:",
    sum(is.na(oil_full$oil_price)), "\n\n")

# 3. Merge بر اساس تقویم کامل 
final_data <- full_cal %>%
  left_join(sales_daily %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)), by = "date") %>%
  left_join(trans_daily %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)), by = "date") %>%
  left_join(oil_full %>% select(date, oil_price) %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date)), by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date)

cat("تعداد مقادیر گمشده در هر ستون:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(final_data)))

write.csv(final_data, "final_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

#  تجزیه سری زمانی (Decomposition)
sales_ts <- ts(final_data$sales, frequency = 7)  # فصل هفتگی
decomp <- stl(sales_ts, s.window = "periodic")
plot(decomp, main = "تجزیه سری زمانی Sales (Trend / Seasonal / Remainder)")
```



```{r}
#4
# بررسی ایستایی

check_stationarity <- function(series, name) {
  acf(series, lag.max = 30, main = paste("ACF -", name))
  pacf(series, lag.max = 30, main = paste("PACF -", name))

  adf_result <- adf.test(series)
  cat("آزمون ADF -", name, ":\n")
  cat("  آماره:", round(adf_result$statistic, 3), "\n")
  cat("  p-value:", round(adf_result$p.value, 4), "\n")
  if (adf_result$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("  نتیجه: سری ایستاست (رد فرض صفر)\n")
  } else {
    cat("  نتیجه: سری ایستا نیست (عدم رد فرض صفر) -> نیاز به تفاضل گیری\n")
  }

  d_needed <- ndiffs(series)
  cat("  تعداد تفاضل گیری پیشنهادی (ndiffs):", d_needed, "\n")

  return(d_needed)
}

trans_ts <- ts(final_data$transactions, frequency = 7)
oil_ts   <- ts(final_data$oil_price,    frequency = 7)

d_sales <- check_stationarity(sales_ts, "Sales")
d_trans <- check_stationarity(trans_ts, "Transactions")
d_oil   <- check_stationarity(oil_ts,   "Oil Price")

#تفاضل گیری از Sales  
if (d_sales > 0) {
  sales_diff <- diff(sales_ts, differences = d_sales)
  cat("\nبعد از", d_sales, "بار تفاضل گیری، سری Sales:\n")
  plot(sales_diff, main = paste("Sales بعد از", d_sales, "بار تفاضل گیری"))
  acf(sales_diff, lag.max = 30, main = "ACF - Sales (Differenced)")
  pacf(sales_diff, lag.max = 30, main = "PACF - Sales (Differenced)")

  adf_diff <- adf.test(sales_diff)
  cat("آزمون ADF بعد از تفاضل گیری - p-value:", round(adf_diff$p.value, 4), "\n")
  
cat("آزمون KPSS برای Sales \n")
print(kpss.test(sales_ts, null = "Level"))

cat("\n آزمون KPSS برای Transactions \n")
print(kpss.test(trans_ts, null = "Level"))

cat("\n آزمون KPSS برای Oil Price \n")
print(kpss.test(oil_ts, null = "Level"))
}
```
```{r}
#5.1
#  Model Fitting

#  Best Non-seasonal ARIMA
best_arima <- auto.arima(
  sales_ts,
  seasonal = FALSE,
  stepwise = FALSE,
  approximation = FALSE
)
cat(" Best Non-seasonal ARIMA \n")
summary(best_arima)


# Educational Comparison Models

# AR Model
ar_model <- Arima(sales_ts, order = c(1,1,0))
cat("\n AR(1,1,0)\n")
summary(ar_model)


# MA Model
ma_model <- Arima(sales_ts, order = c(0,1,1))
cat("\nMA(0,1,1) \n")
summary(ma_model)


# ARMA Model
arma_model <- Arima(sales_ts, order = c(1,1,1))
cat("\nARMA(1,1,1) \n")
summary(arma_model)


#  Best Seasonal SARIMA
sarima_model <- auto.arima(
  sales_ts,
  seasonal = TRUE,
  stepwise = FALSE,
  approximation = FALSE
)
cat("\n Best Seasonal SARIMA \n")
summary(sarima_model)
```



```{r}
#5.2
# مقایسه مدل ها
models_list <- list(
  "AR(1,1,0)"                          = ar_model,
  "MA(0,1,1)"                          = ma_model,
  "ARMA(1,1,1)"                        = arma_model,
  "ARIMA auto.arima (non-seasonal)"    = best_arima,
  "SARIMA (weekly)"                    = sarima_model,
  "Reg w/ ARIMA errors (transactions)" = xreg_model
)

comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = names(models_list),
  AIC   = sapply(models_list, AIC),
  BIC   = sapply(models_list, BIC),
  RMSE  = sapply(models_list, function(m) accuracy(m)[1, "RMSE"])
) %>% arrange(AIC)

# اختلاف هر مدل با بهترین مدل
comparison$DeltaAIC <- comparison$AIC - min(comparison$AIC)
print(comparison)
```

```{r}
#7
#  Out-of-Sample Validation (Train/Test Split)

n <- length(sales_ts)
h_test <- 30

train_ts <- window(sales_ts, end = time(sales_ts)[n - h_test])
test_ts  <- window(sales_ts, start = time(sales_ts)[n - h_test + 1])

# برازش مدل روی داده های آموزش
train_model <- auto.arima(
  train_ts,
  seasonal = TRUE,
  stepwise = FALSE,
  approximation = FALSE
)

fc_test <- forecast(train_model, h = h_test)

cat("\n----- Out-of-Sample Forecast Accuracy -----\n")
print(accuracy(fc_test, test_ts))

# نمایش پیش بینی در کنار مقادیر واقعی
autoplot(fc_test) +
  autolayer(test_ts, series = "Actual") +
  labs(
    title = "Out-of-Sample Forecast (Last 30 Days)",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Sales"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
